title: LCM of Two Numbers

content.problemStatement: Find the LCM of the given two numbers.

solution.approach: Compute Least Common Multiple (LCM) using relationship LCM(a, b) = (a * b) / GCD(a, b).
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Use Euclidean algorithm to find GCD, then calculate LCM = (a / GCD(a, b)) * b.
